"Cloud smokeping" generally refers to hosting the Smokeping network latency monitoring tool on a cloud server (like AWS, DigitalOcean, Linode, or Google Cloud) rather than on a local machine.
Doing this allows you to monitor the latency and uptime of your local network, servers, or websites from an external, highly available vantage point.
Are you looking to set up a Smokeping instance in the cloud, perhaps using Docker or a specific cloud provider?
